plan_metadata.primary_objective: Deliver a credible analyst-facing Gradio demo that can run all supplied cases through the real backend, isolate per-case failures, persist successful results, and navigate completed analyst-review packages.
plan_metadata.paused_programme_checkpoint: Policy-v4 P1 complete; P2 through P8 not started

changes_already_present: Non-executable source-derived semantic contracts for all 26 audited requirements
Strict Pydantic models and tests for those semantic contracts
protected_assets: All historical run, selection, resolution, evaluation, recommendation, review-package and analyst-decision records

delivery_principles: Preserve take-home-v3 as the existing working and historical pipeline.
Do not mutate historical records or reinterpret v3 outputs.
Keep Gradio as a presentation adapter over an application service.
Use one immutable lineage per case attempt.
Persist sanitized failure outcomes as well as successful package identifiers.
Never store credentials, raw secrets or unredacted provider errors.
Never label cached persisted output as a live run.
Never let one case failure terminate the remaining batch.
Correct only policy defects approved as demo-critical.
Escalate rather than introducing an unsafe flat-fact shortcut.

included: Application service for case catalogue, individual execution, batch execution, progress, review packages and evidence display targets
Persistent batch and per-case execution state
Real sequential execution of all ten supplied cases
Minimal multi-case adaptation of the existing Gradio interface
One-command local demo startup and operator documentation
deferred: General structured-record framework beyond what a critical correction strictly requires
Generic workflow scheduler or distributed job queue
New evidence upload and post-review continuation
REST or FastAPI unless a second client requires it
Provider comparison, replay and model experimentation
Automatic representment submission or any external action

modules.responsibility: Immutable application DTOs for case queue items, execution attempts, batches, progress events and analyst case views.
Append-only SQLite persistence for demo batches and per-case attempts.
Stable case execution and retrieval API used by CLI and Gradio.
One-command Gradio demo entry point and mode selection.

service_interface.behaviour: Return every case from cases.json in source order, enriched with the latest persisted attempt state.
Create one fresh immutable lineage, execute every machine stage, persist status transitions, and return a completed package or sanitized failure.
Queue all cases, execute them sequentially, catch failures per case, persist each outcome, and continue.
Return the latest persisted state without invoking the pipeline.
Load and integrity-check the package linked from the latest completed attempt without rerunning extraction.
Assemble package, facts, citations, evidence display targets and lineage into a presentation DTO; return an explicitly empty detail state for non-completed cases.
Use the existing integrity-checked evidence presentation adapter; never discover undeclared directory files.

stage_order: Select exact approved demo rulebook policy
execution_orchestrator.failure_rule: Catch a typed or unexpected exception at the per-case boundary, sanitize it, mark only that attempt FAILED, emit a progress event, and continue the batch.
execution_orchestrator.retry_rule: An explicit retry creates a new attempt and new immutable pipeline lineage. A completed attempt is loaded for viewing and is never silently rerun.
execution_orchestrator.provider_rule: One configured provider and model are used exactly; no fallback or substitution.

persistence.database: A dedicated demo or validation SQLite database selected at startup

new_tables.name: demo_case_attempts
constraints: status is NOT_RUN, QUEUED, RUNNING, COMPLETED or FAILED
FAILED requires sanitized error fields and no fabricated package
no updates to upstream immutable lineage records

transaction_rules: Atomically persist RUNNING with start time.
Each upstream stage keeps its existing transaction and immutability rules.
Atomically finalize the application attempt as COMPLETED or FAILED.
Batch summary updates never overwrite individual case outcomes.

gradio.design_rule: Adapt the existing interface; do not rebuild it.
new_components: Compact case queue or selector with all cases
Clearly visible LIVE or CACHED RESULT label
gradio.callback_rule: Callbacks may call application-service operations and render returned DTOs only. They must not import policy evaluators, extraction adapters or recommendation mappers.

selection_behaviour.COMPLETED: Load the persisted package and evidence targets without rerunning.
selection_behaviour.NOT_RUN: Clear prior case details and show NOT_RUN.
selection_behaviour.QUEUED: Clear prior case details and show QUEUED.
selection_behaviour.RUNNING: Clear prior case details and show RUNNING.
selection_behaviour.FAILED: Clear prior case details and show sanitized failure information.

gradio.batch_progress: The Gradio callback consumes application-service progress events and yields queue-only updates while the backend processes each case.

demo_modes.description: Run controls invoke the real backend and configured provider once per case attempt.
Load only genuine persisted completed attempts and packages. Never call a provider or create a simulated result.
requirements: Existing validation database containing completed attempts
ui_rules: Show NOT_RUN or FAILED for cases without a completed persisted package.

versioning_strategy.reason: Avoid claiming completion of the paused full policy-v4 fidelity programme.
versioning_strategy.construction: Port all eight policies for exact catalogue coverage; change only approved critical semantics and record known non-critical inherited limitations.
versioning_strategy.historical_rule: Never edit take-home-v3 or reuse a v3 downstream result as a v4-demo result.

feasibility_gate.objective: Determine whether each critical correction can be represented safely with a narrow additive fact or predicate change.
required_output: TRUE, FALSE and UNKNOWN contract cases
escalate_if: Visa 13.3 material description comparison requires probabilistic free-text judgement inside evaluation
A correction would count or compare unpaired parallel arrays
A record-search zero result cannot retain explicit scope and period
Mastercard 4859 timing cannot preserve booking, cancellation and policy-window association
Historical v3 payloads would need rewriting
An undefined threshold, tolerance or materiality rule must be invented
feasibility_gate.decision: If any escalation condition is true, pause that policy and request approval for the minimum structured-fact redesign before claiming all-case demo readiness.

target: Compare source-qualified published and delivered attributes through approved deterministic rules.
Do not require photo, specification and serial routes cumulatively.
Evaluate return/non-use and post-complaint-use/retention as independent alternatives.
Require positive scoped zero-result evidence for non-use; NOT_FOUND remains UNKNOWN.
Evaluate no-show OR cancellation after the calculated policy cutoff.
Preserve booking, service, cancellation and policy-window association.
Do not let any recorded cancellation satisfy the late-cancellation route.
Default to the approved do-not-represent or accept-liability vocabulary when issuer miscoding is not positively proven.
Do not use generic insufficient evidence for the source-defined default.
corrections.approval_blocker: Product owner must select the exact advisory vocabulary: RECOMMEND_DO_NOT_REPRESENT or ACCEPT_LIABILITY.

target: Replace exact full-address-to-postcode equality with the existing versioned material-address comparison.

implementation_sequence.name: Checkpoint and demo contract
tasks: Preserve and commit the current P0/P1 checkpoint separately from demo work.
Record v3 hashes, database hashes and the 291-pass baseline.
Define application DTOs and service protocols before UI changes.
Define sanitized failure policy and demo-mode labels.
gate: take-home-v3 immutability test passes.
No historical database changed.
No live provider call occurs.

implementation_sequence.name: Stable application service and persistence
tasks: Implement case catalogue and queue DTOs.
Implement append-only batch and attempt repository.
Wrap existing pipeline stages in run_case.
Implement run_all_cases with per-case exception isolation.
Implement package, case-view and evidence retrieval.
Add a non-UI CLI or test harness for the service.
tests: All ten cases list in source order.
State transitions follow NOT_RUN to QUEUED to RUNNING to COMPLETED or FAILED.
One injected failure does not prevent later cases from executing.
Failed and unprocessed views contain no stale case details.
No credential appears in attempts or errors.
gate: Application service can run fixture-backed cases without Gradio.
Failure isolation integration test passes.
Existing tests remain green.

implementation_sequence.name: Critical-policy feasibility and correction
tasks: Run the critical-policy feasibility gate.
Escalate any required broad structured-fact redesign before coding it.
Create take-home-v4-demo only after feasibility approval.
Implement approved narrow facts, predicates and outcome mapping.
Port unchanged policies with explicit inherited-limitations metadata.
Add source-derived TRUE, FALSE and UNKNOWN tests for every corrected requirement.
gate: No v3 asset changes.
Every corrected relationship is actually evaluated.
NOT_FOUND remains UNKNOWN.
Visa 10.5 has an approved default outcome.
All eight supplied case keys have an exact demo policy.

implementation_sequence.name: Real all-case validation
tasks: Provision a fresh dedicated validation database.
Import the approved demo rulebook.
Run each supplied case sequentially through the application service.
Persist every completed package and every sanitized failure.
Capture non-secret model identity and existing lineage metadata.
Produce a ten-case validation summary.
gate: All ten attempts reach COMPLETED or FAILED.
A failure does not terminate later attempts.
Every COMPLETED attempt links to an integrity-checked package.
No result is labelled live unless a provider call occurred.
No analyst decision or external action is automatically created.

implementation_sequence.name: Minimal multi-case Gradio adaptation
tasks: Add the case queue and two run controls to the existing layout.
Add deterministic component reset for non-completed selections.
Bind selection to get_case_view.
Bind live run buttons to application-service progress events.
Reuse existing package and evidence rendering.
Add collapsible technical lineage and advisory/cached labels.
gate: No policy or extraction module is imported by UI callbacks.
All ten cases appear.
Selecting each completed case displays only its persisted data.
Selecting FAILED or NOT_RUN clears prior details.
Existing analyst actions continue to work for completed packages.

implementation_sequence.name: Cached-result presentation mode
tasks: Add explicit LIVE and CACHED_VIEW startup modes.
Disable provider execution in CACHED_VIEW.
Load completed packages from the selected database.
Label cached results and incomplete cases honestly.
gate: Network and provider factories are not called in CACHED_VIEW.
No synthetic recommendation or package is created.
Cached completed cases remain inspectable with provider unavailable.

implementation_sequence.name: Demo packaging and local verification
tasks: Add one documented startup command.
Document live configuration, validation database and cached mode.
Add a concise operator script for live and cached demonstrations.
Run offline tests and the gated provider test.
Perform one approved local ten-case live validation.
Manually verify case navigation, evidence display and stale-state clearing.
gate: README instructions reproduce the demo from a clean shell.
Complete offline regression suite passes.
Gated provider test passes.
Demo starts with one command.
No remaining successful case lacks an analyst-review package.

integration: Injected case failure followed by later successful case

observability_and_limitations.demo_rule: Do not display unavailable metrics as zero. Display NOT RECORDED.
observability_and_limitations.deferred_observability: Token, latency and cost capture may be added after the demo unless the selected provider exposes them through a small, non-invasive adapter change.

acceptance_criteria: The UI lists all ten supplied cases.
Run All Cases invokes the real application backend once per case attempt.
A failed case does not terminate the batch.
Every successful case has a persisted immutable review package.
Selecting a completed case never reruns it.
Selecting an incomplete or failed case never displays stale prior-case data.
Facts retain direct citations and evidence display targets.
Cached results are visibly labelled and are never simulated.
The demo starts with one documented command.

approval_gates.decision: Approve this target plan and application-service persistence design before implementation.
Approve or reject any structured-fact expansion identified by the critical-policy feasibility gate.
Approve the dedicated database and real ten-case live run, which incurs model calls.

backend: Completed packages are retrievable without rerun.
policy: Approved critical defects are corrected or explicitly blocked.
No v3 asset or historical result changed.
Known non-critical inherited limitations are disclosed.
ui: Run controls call only the application service.
Existing analyst presentation and workflow are preserved.
Cached and live outputs are distinguishable.
verification: All ten cases have persisted COMPLETED or FAILED attempts.
Every successful case opens correctly in the existing analyst UI.
